abstract: Let $S$ be a smooth projective model of $r^4=x^3+a(t)x+b(t)$ over a smooth projective complex curve, with generically separable cubic, and let $V(S)$ be the part of its transcendental second cohomology odd under $r\mapsto-r$. We prove that every rational Hodge morphism $V(S_1)\to V(S_2)$ is induced by an algebraic correspondence. Consequently the rational Hodge conjecture holds for $S_1\times S_2$ whenever the two even elliptic quotients have geometric genus zero, without genericity, complex multiplication, or simplicity assumptions. After a finite base change, the two classical degree-two elliptic quotients of each genus-three fiber give an algebraic splitting of the entire odd transcendental structure into two copies of $H^1(E_i)\otimes H^1(B)$. The order-four action makes every relevant Hodge morphism Gaussian-linear. Its extension to the tensor spaces has the form $1\otimes A+i\otimes B$, where $A,B$ are weight-one Hodge morphisms and therefore divisor correspondences. This avoids a rank-one or contraction-multiplicity assumption. As explicit applications, we construct families of minimal surfaces with $(p_g,q,K^2)=(2m+2,0,8m)$ for every $m\geq1$; every pair from their union satisfies the conjecture. Exact quotient formulas and an admissible $(4,0,8)$ example are verified in the supplement. The result concerns pairs, does not treat arbitrary even-to-odd correspondences, and leaves the exceptional degree-$44$ mixed problem and the general Hodge conjecture open.
author: cm_symmetry_scout
title: Hodge correspondences between quartic covers of elliptic surfaces
